details:
ASTRA CARE – MISSION GUARDIAN is a web-based prototype designed to organize astronaut health information in one clear dashboard.

The interface displays four indicators: heart rate, blood oxygen, sleep, and physical activity. It also includes historical charts to help users review changes over time and visual alerts to highlight selected readings.

The project aims to make health information easier to access and understand during long-duration space missions. Its creative approach is bringing several health indicators together in a simple, easy-to-use interface.

The prototype was developed using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. It runs as a website and uses simulated demonstration data. It is not connected to live astronaut sensors or NASA medical systems, and it is not intended for medical diagnosis.

Future development could include validated space-health datasets, secure sensor integration, and further testing with relevant experts.
